MX-14
MANUAL TRANS AXLE (C56) - MANUAL TRANSAXLE ASSEMBLY
9. REMOVE LOCK BALL ASSEMBLY AND CONTROL
SHAFT COVER
{a) Remove the lock ball assembly.
Sealant:
Part No. 08833-00080, THREE BOND 1344, LOCTITE
242 or equivalent
Torque: 29 N,m (300 kgf-cm, 22 ft,lbf)
{b) Remove the 4 bolts and control shaft cover with the gas­
y ket.
Sealant:
Part No. 08833-00080, THREE BONO 1344, LOCTITE
242 or equivalent
Torque: 20 N-m (200 kgf-cm, 14 ft-lbf)
10. REMOVE SHIFT AND SELECT LEVER SHAFT ASM
SEMBLY
NOTICE:
At the time of reassembly, please refer to the following
item.
Set the claws of the shift interlock plate Into the shift head
part of the gear shift fork shaft securely.
11. REMOVE LOCK NUT
(a) Engage the gear double meshing.
(b) Using a chisel and hammer, loosen the staked part of the
nut
(c) Remove the lock nut.
Torque: 118 N.m (1,200 kgf.cm, 87 fl-lbf)
(d) Disengage the gear double meshing.
12. REMOVE NO. 3 HUB SLEEVE ANO NO. 3 GEAR SHIFT
FORK
(a) Remove the bolt from the No. 3 gear shift fork.
Torque: 16 N.m (160 kgf-cm, 12 ft,lbf)
Sealant:
Part No. 08833-00080, THREE BOND 1344, LOCTITE
242 or equivalent
(b) Remove the No. 3 hub sleeve with the No. 3 gear shift
fork.
HINT:
At the time of reassembly, please refer to the following items.
• Install the No. 3 clutch hub assembly to the No. 3 hub
sleeve.
